title: clinopodium graveolens subsp. rotundifolium
intro: Clinopodium graveolens subsp. rotundifolium, commonly known as Round-leaved Calamint, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to alleviate digestive issues, such as bloating and cramps. The health benefits of Clinopodium graveolens subsp. rotundifolium include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, which contribute to its therapeutic effects in reducing pain and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, including limonene, linalool, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
